# Generated/

**Do not edit anything in this folder directly.**

This folder is populated by `dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold` in Lesson 2 Exercise 3. The next time the scaffold command runs with `--force` (new column on a scaffolded table, new table added to the Sales schema), every file in here is rewritten whole. Any in-place edits are lost silently.

All convention overrides and customizations live in `../Conventions/` as sibling partial-class files. See `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for the full convention.
